{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the count of completed orders
completed_count = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]

total_rows = df.shape[0]

print(f'Completed orders: {completed_count}')
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')
print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')

# Confirm that there are no other status values
print('\nUnique status values:', df['status'].unique())"}
